name: Klockmort Spannerspan
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details: I made a copy of my notes on the techniques I learned while making your armor, and need someone to take them to Klockmort Spannerspan.  He's a gnomish blacksmith in Ironforge and when he learns what I've learned... I bet he'll pull off his own beard in excitement.
narrative.objectives: Bring Furen's Notes to Klockmort Spannerspan.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Oh my! These notes are amazing! And what's more... they're incredible and they're stupendous and they make my knees go all a-wobbly!

Furen had a breakthrough! A real breakthrough! I can't wait to try out his new technique!
narrative.requestItemsText: Good day, or morning or evening. I can't tell from way down here. So do you have business for me?

chain.subtitle: 7 quests from level 20 to 30, 9,575 XP in all.

quests.name: The Rethban Gauntlet
quests.objectiveText: Enter the Rethban Caverns, reach the first fork, and return to Yorus Barleybrew within the time allowed. You must not die and release your spirit.

quests.name: The Shieldsmith
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Cask of Scalder to Furen Longbeard.

quests.name: Fire Hardened Mail
quests.objectiveText: Gather the materials Furen Longbeard requires, and bring them to him in Stormwind.

quests.name: Klockmort Spannerspan
quests.objectiveText: Bring Furen's Notes to Klockmort Spannerspan.

quests.name: Iron Coral
quests.objectiveText: Bring 20 loads of Searing Coral to Klockmort Spannerspan in Ironforge.
